free_tier.stated: Volumes include up to 1 TiB free.

per_object_cap.notes: there’s no file size limit for individual files in a volume

retention.stated: 500,000 inodes per Volume; 1 TiB free per workspace; volumes snapshot once/day for billing (deleted data can bill up to 4 days); $30/mo compute is the real ceiling. Serving costs CPU-seconds, so throughput is bounded by the credit, not the disk.
retention.notes: We calculate usage by snapshotting your total storage once a day. When you delete data, you may still be billed for that storage for up to four days, to reflect our underlying processing costs.

egress.terms: 1 TiB/billing cycle included on Starter, then $0.04/GiB. Metered but with a 1 TiB monthly floor. Explicitly: 'Reads from and writes to Modal Volumes do not count as network egress.'.

interface_detail: Volumes come with a fully-featured filesystem interface for easy integration into your favorite ML tools and frameworks.
tooling: `modal` Python SDK + `modal volume put/get/ls` CLI; volumes mount as a POSIX filesystem inside containers. Anyone who needs S3 semantics writes a tiny FastAPI shim on a web endpoint.
chaining: 1 TiB free volume per workspace x N free workspaces (Starter allows 3 users/workspace, workspaces themselves are free) => multi-TiB at zero cost. Each TiB is fully read-write and persists with no session attached.

limits.value: deleted data can bill up to 4 days

limits_note: 500,000 inodes per Volume; 1 TiB free per workspace; volumes snapshot once/day for billing (deleted data can bill up to 4 days); $30/mo compute is the real ceiling. Serving costs CPU-seconds, so throughput is bounded by the credit, not the disk.
reliability_note: Data persists independent of compute and survives container shutdown; the failure mode is billing, not deletion. Exceed $30/mo of compute and the workspace needs a card.
